basic_details.job_title: MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow or Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad), Prayagraj, has invited applications from Indian nationals for 1 post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I on contract in the ANRF-funded project "Design and Implementation of Efficient Strategies for Accelerating Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted MRI in Comprehensive Cancer Screening". The pay is Rs.37,000 per month plus 20% HRA (Rs.44,400) for GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualified JRF, or Rs.30,000 per month plus 20% HRA (Rs.36,000) for Project Associate-I. The e

how_to_apply: Prepare the duly completed application on the prescribed format, along with copies of supporting documents.
Send it so that it reaches Research & Consultancy Cell, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 on or before 04/12/2026.

Superscript the envelope as "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I (on contract) in the Research Project titled Design and Implementation of Efficient Strategies for Accelerating Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted MRI in Comprehensive Cancer Screening".
Also send a soft copy of the application to Dr. Prasun Chandra Tripathi, Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Principal Investigator, through email [email protected].
Give a valid email address in the application, because the interview date is informed to shortlisted candidates by email.
important_instructions: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted. The Institute reserves the right to reject any application at any time and to consider candidates with exceptional credentials even if they have not applied. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The position is purely temporary and is governed by the funding agency rules and service conditions of the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad.

content_sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad
Design and Implementation of Efficient Strategies for Accelerating Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted MRI in Comprehensive Cancer Screening (Project File no. ANRF/ECRG/2024/005934/ENS)
Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant (PMECRG) – Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I (on contract)
JRF: Rs.37,000 per month + 20% HRA = Rs.44,400; Project Associate-I: Rs.30,000 per month + 20% HRA = Rs.36,000
28 years on the last date of application
Application on prescribed format sent to the Research & Consultancy Cell, with a soft copy by email to the Principal Investigator

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals for the one position advertised. The age limit is 28 years on the last date of application. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates. Desirable skills: Basic knowledge of Machine Learning models Basic proficiency in Python programming Familiarity with High Performance Computing (HPC) environments Understanding of Image Processing fundamentals Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.post: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I
rows.essential_qualification: M.E./M.Tech./MCA or B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science / Information Technology / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics Engineering or related branches with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA
rows.desirable: Preference to GATE or CSIR-UGC NET qualified candidates

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure of appointment is 1 year, extendable by 6 months. The project itself is funded for 18 months. A candidate selected as Junior Research Fellow may register for Ph.D. if the eligibility conditions set by the institute are met by him/her.

rows.post: Project Associate-I (if not qualified GATE/CSIR-UGC NET)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare the duly completed application on the prescribed format, along with copies of supporting documents. Send it so that it reaches Research & Consultancy Cell, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 on or before 04/12/2026. Superscript the envelope as "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I (on contract) in the Research Project titled Design and Implementation of Efficient Strategies for Accelerating Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted MRI in Comprehensive Cancer Screening". Also send a soft copy of the application to Dr. Prasun Chandra Tripathi, Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Principal Investigator, through email [email protected] . Give a valid email address in the application, because the interview date is informed to shortlisted candidates by email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not guarantee that a candidate will be called for an interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date via email. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Shortlisted candidates must appear on the specified date with: An updated CV Details of publications (if any) Original and self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and certificates supporting their academic qualifications A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for applicants employed in private, government or any other organisation

rows.event: Last date for the application to reach the Research & Consultancy Cell

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted. The Institute reserves the right to reject any application at any time and to consider candidates with exceptional credentials even if they have not applied. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The position is purely temporary and is governed by the funding agency rules and service conditions of the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 1 position, for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I on contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad on or before 04/12/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: M.E./M.Tech./MCA or B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science / Information Technology / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics Engineering or related branches with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Preference is given to GATE or CSIR-UGC NET qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years on the last date of application, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: JRF (GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualified) gets Rs.37,000 per month plus 20% HRA, i.e. Rs.44,400. Project Associate-I (if not qualified) gets Rs.30,000 per month plus 20% HRA, i.e. Rs.36,000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application on the prescribed format with copies of supporting documents to the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004, and also email a soft copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and the requirements of the project, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, with the date sent by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is on contract and is purely temporary. The tenure is 1 year, extendable by 6 months.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice gives pay as Rs.37,000 or Rs.30,000 per month plus 20% HRA, making Rs.44,400 and Rs.36,000 respectively.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
